def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    sell_premium = 6
    buy_premium = 2
    sell_strike = 110
    stock_price_at_expiry = 105
    contract_multiplier = 100

    # Calculate the net credit and loss from the short put
    net_credit = sell_premium - buy_premium
    profit_loss_per_share = net_credit - (sell_strike - stock_price_at_expiry)
    answer = round(profit_loss_per_share * contract_multiplier)

    # return answer
    return answer
